target_customer: Payment providers, neobanks, marketplaces and treasury teams moving money across borders
problem: Moving money globally is slow and costly on traditional rails. Infinite offers APIs and SDKs for stablecoin payments, later adding bank accounts and compliance agents.
product_category: B2B stablecoin payment processing and compliance

founders.name: Nikhil Srinivasan
previous_startups: Prior YC S12 company acquired by Coinbase (name not stated on page)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: platform product lead at Sardine and Coinbase.

founders.name: Raj Lad
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: payments tech lead at Sardine, launched stablecoin payments and credit risk workflows.

competitors.name: Bridge
competitors.funding_then: about $58M venture funding per secondary report

competitors.name: Conduit
competitors.what: Cross-border B2B payments on stablecoin rails

technical_complexity.rationale: Payments APIs with compliance, banking partners and stablecoin rails; founders have payments experience at Sardine, Stripe, Adyen alumni.

defensibility.rationale: Licensing and compliance integrations help, but Stripe/Bridge and BVNK were far ahead.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Stripe closed Bridge in 2025-02; BVNK was later reported in acquisition deals by secondary sources, unverified here.

market_need_then: Stablecoin volumes and investor interest rose through 2024 and 2025 and regulation became clearer, with B2B cross-border payments a core use case.

branding.domain_note: Uses infinite.net; another source mentions infinite.dev.

identity.voice_and_tone: confident and concise; footer 'Made with love in Presidio, SF'

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word that is hard to search, with the legal entity named Infinite Agents, Inc.; trade press covers the product launch.

pivots.to: AI-native payments and compliance with bank accounts via Erebor Bank
pivots.why: Product expansion announced by The Block; reasons not stated.

outcome_analysis: Infinite is an active Winter 2025 company from payments veterans, one with a prior exit to Coinbase. It launched bank accounts through Erebor in April 2026, widening the product. Funding is unverified. The main risk is well-funded Stripe-Bridge and BVNK in the same wedge.
notes: Funding unverified: a directory lists $6.0M total seed; a blog teardown claims a $550K Series B and conflicts. No primary source, so no round recorded. Education not found. The Block article did not state funding. The pivot entry is a product expansion, not a true pivot. Conduit date and details not established.
